sub_graphs.title: EIP-3540: EOF Container Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation process for EOF containers at deployment time

nodes.label: Bytecode Received for Deployment
nodes.description: Raw bytecode submitted for contract deployment

nodes.label: Check Magic Bytes
nodes.description: Verify if bytecode starts with 0xEF00 magic sequence

nodes.label: Legacy Bytecode Detected
nodes.description: Bytecode does not start with 0xEF00 - process as legacy EVM code

nodes.label: EOF Container Detected
nodes.description: Bytecode starts with 0xEF00 - process as EOF format

nodes.label: Validate Version Byte
nodes.description: Check version byte is 0x01 (not 0x00 which is reserved for legacy)

nodes.label: Invalid EOF Version
nodes.description: Version byte is 0x00 or unsupported - deployment fails

nodes.label: Version Valid
nodes.description: EOF version 1 confirmed

nodes.label: Parse EOF Header
nodes.description: Extract section kinds, sizes, and terminator from header

nodes.label: Validate Section Order
nodes.description: Verify sections appear in required order: type, code, [container], data, terminator

nodes.label: Invalid Section Order
nodes.description: Sections not in required order - deployment fails

nodes.label: Validate Type Section Size
nodes.description: Check type_size is divisible by 4 and matches code section count

nodes.label: Validate Code Sections
nodes.description: Verify at least 1 code section, each has size >= 1

nodes.label: Validate Total Container Size
nodes.description: Check total size does not exceed MAX_INITCODE_SIZE (49152 bytes)

nodes.label: Container Size Exceeded
nodes.description: Total container size exceeds MAX_INITCODE_SIZE - deployment fails

nodes.label: Check for Stray Bytes
nodes.description: Verify no bytes exist outside declared sections

nodes.label: Stray Bytes Found
nodes.description: Extra bytes outside sections - deployment fails

nodes.label: EOF Container Valid
nodes.description: All validation checks passed - container ready for deployment

edges.label: Code sections valid - check total size
Size valid - check for stray bytes

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3540: EOF Opcode Restrictions
sub_graphs.description: Models which opcodes are rejected in EOF contracts for security

nodes.label: EOF Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: Next opcode fetched from EOF code section

nodes.label: Check Opcode Allowed
nodes.description: Verify opcode is not in EOF rejected list

nodes.description: Opcode permitted in EOF - proceed with execution

nodes.label: Opcode Rejected

nodes.description: For DELEGATECALL, verify target is also EOF contract

edges.label: Not in reject list: CODESIZE, CODECOPY, EXTCODESIZE, EXTCODECOPY, EXTCODEHASH, GAS, CALL, DELEGATECALL, STATICCALL

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3540: Legacy Contract Viewing EOF Code
sub_graphs.description: Models how legacy contracts see EOF contract code (limited visibility)

nodes.label: Legacy Contract Queries EOF
nodes.description: Legacy contract using EXTCODE* opcodes on EOF target

nodes.label: EXTCODESIZE on EOF Target
nodes.description: Legacy contract calls EXTCODESIZE on EOF contract

nodes.label: EXTCODESIZE Returns 2
nodes.description: EXTCODESIZE always returns 2 for EOF contracts (length of 0xEF00)

nodes.label: EXTCODECOPY on EOF Target
nodes.description: Legacy contract calls EXTCODECOPY on EOF contract

nodes.label: EXTCODECOPY Returns EF00
nodes.description: EXTCODECOPY returns up to 2 bytes from 0xEF00 only

nodes.label: EXTCODEHASH on EOF Target
nodes.description: Legacy contract calls EXTCODEHASH on EOF contract

nodes.label: EXTCODEHASH Returns Fixed Hash
nodes.description: Returns keccak256(0xEF00) = 0x9dbf3648...

ambiguities.text: The spec says data body 'may be shorter' than declared size for undeployed containers but doesn't specify how to handle this during execution
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume deployed containers must have data body matching declared size exactly; the 'shorter' allowance is only for initcode/factory scenarios.

ambiguities.text: The behavior of nested container sections (kind 0x03) is not fully specified in this EIP
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nested containers follow the same validation rules recursively, with each validated independently.

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify what happens if an EOF contract tries to SELFDESTRUCT
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume SELFDESTRUCT is in the reject list for EOF contracts based on the DELEGATECALL restriction rationale.

implicit_assumptions.description: Once validated at deployment, EOF containers cannot be modified and remain valid for their lifetime
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If contract code could be modified post-deployment, the one-time validation guarantee would be broken

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot craft bytecode that passes EOF validation but behaves differently than validated
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Potential for validation bypass leading to execution of unvalidated or malformed code

implicit_assumptions.description: All clients implement identical validation logic to ensure consensus on what is valid EOF
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent validation could cause consensus splits where some clients accept contracts others reject

implicit_assumptions.description: The 0xEF magic byte was previously invalid, so no legitimate existing contracts start with it
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Existing contracts could be misinterpreted as EOF, breaking backward compatibility
